description: This source file contains the implementation of the 'Category' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog' namespace. It provides methods for managing categories, including adding, editing, deleting, repairing categories, handling category descriptions, paths, SEO URLs, layouts, and related database operations in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents the Category model responsible for category management operations such as creation, update, deletion, and maintenance within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Inserts a new category into the database, creates descriptions, paths, SEO URLs, layouts, store associations, and manages hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category's details, including descriptions, SEO URLs, paths, layouts, store associations, and handles cleanup of old data.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Removes a category and all its associated descriptions, filters, stores, layouts, and SEO URLs. Also cleans up related product and category path data.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Reconstructs the category hierarchy, re-establishes paths, and ensures consistency within the category tree structure.
